newsitem.title: USA: BAB Holdings buys Northern Calif. stores.
newsitem.headline: BAB Holdings buys Northern Calif. stores.

text.p: BAB Holdings Inc, operator of Big Apple Bagels, said Wednesday it has acquired the assets of a franchisee, Danville Bagel Company Inc, which has two operating Big Apple Bagel stores and eight additional stores in development in Northern California.

The eight stores in development are scheduled to begin opening later this month, and all eight stores should be operating by March 1997. All of the stores acquired will be operated as company-owned stores.

"The two stores currently in operation combined with the eight stores in development will be a significant addition to revenues in 1997," said Michael Evans, BAB Holdings' president and chief executive officer, in a statement.
Including today's agreement and the expected acquisition of Chesapeake Bagel Bakery, BAB expects 325-350 units in operation by its November fiscal year-end.
